unmapped_blocks.text: Summary of Experience
4+ Years Working experience in developing applications Java and Spring-Boot 
 Having good knowledge of Front-End using Angular
 Good understanding of Relational (mySql) & Non-Relational Database (MongoDB).
 Working experience as an Individual contributor, developing, and delivering application .
 TATA Consultancy Service f Pvt Ltd rom Feb 2022 to Oct 2025.
 G7CR Tech Ind Pvt Ltd from July 2021 to Dec 2021.
Academic Background
B.Tech (with stream CSE) from Punjab Technical University .
Project #1
Project Title : PDP (Payment Dashboard Program) -- ( jan/2025 – present)
Client Name : TCS - Product
Environment : Micro-Front-End with Angular, java, Spring-Boot REST API, MicroServices, Git
Description: This application is a part of collecting all type of Pension for an indivisual .
Responsibilities:
o Getting the requirements from Business Analyst team and Client.
o Collaborated with UX and UI designers to translate visual concepts into functional web
components using Angular Material .
o Contributed to back-end experience and collaborated on APIs.
o Mentored junior developers in Angular best practices, coding standards, and effective use of
o
Git version control.
Integrated RESTful APIs into Angular applications, facilitating seamless data exchange
between client and server.
Project #2
Project Title : EDMS (Entity DashBoard Management System) -- oct/2023 – jan/2025)
Client Name : TCS Internal - Product
Environment : React JS, Java with Spring-Boot Rest API Microservices, GIT
Description: This application is used to manage the Claim entity for different Users.
Responsibilities:
o Getting the requirements from Business Analyst team
o Collaborated with different UI designs with inbuilt library Bootstrap
o Also Optimizing performance and fixing Fortify vulnerability
o Used Swagger and Postman, to implementing the Restful API and Swagger gives the rich UI
to test API.
o Worked with SONAR reports, for code testing of the application.
Project #3
Project Title : Digieca --> Tata Steel (July/2022 – sept/2023)
Client Name : TCS Banks
Environment : Java, Spring-Boot Rest API, Angular, GIT
Description: This application is useful for TCS Bank to manage Bank system .
Role : Team Member
Responsibilities:
Responsible for implementing Controller Bean classes.
Written DAO and their implementations.
Worked on response standardization.
Involved implementing the Use Cases and Defect fixing
